```text
backdown pool [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

## backdown pool add {#add}

Make a folder on one of this machine's drives part of the pool (it's created if need be)

```text
backdown pool add [OPTIONS] <PATH>
```

### Arguments

`<PATH>`
: &nbsp;

### Options

`--reserve <SIZE|PCT>`
: Room to keep free on its drive: a size (50G) or a share (5%); 5 % of the drive, at least 20 GB, unless said.

`--takes <PLACES>`
: The top-level places it takes, like Mail,Media (unless said, anything).

## backdown pool list {#list}

Every pool folder of the swarm: this machine's, and the others' as they last said.

```text
backdown pool list [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

`--json`
: Print it as JSON, for scripts.

## backdown pool set {#set}

Change what a pool folder of this machine keeps free or takes.

```text
backdown pool set [OPTIONS] <FOLDER>
```

### Arguments

`<FOLDER>`
: Its path, or its number from `pool list`.

### Options

`--reserve <SIZE|PCT>`
: &nbsp;

`--takes <PLACES>`
: The top-level places it takes (an empty value: anything).

## backdown pool remove {#remove}

Stop treating a folder of this machine as part of the pool (nothing in it is touched)

```text
backdown pool remove [OPTIONS] <FOLDER>
```

### Arguments

`<FOLDER>`
: Its path, or its number from `pool list`.

## backdown pool plan {#plan}

Where a drive's things would go in the pool: what's in it already (by content, on any machine), what's new, and which pool folder each thing goes into. Kept as a pool plan.

```text
backdown pool plan [OPTIONS] <DRIVE>
```

### Arguments

`<DRIVE>`
: The drive: its path as indexed here, or its folder name.

### Options

`--json`
: Print it as JSON, for scripts.

## backdown pool send {#send}

Copy a drive into the pool as its plan says: each file read back there and compared by SHA-256; what's in the pool already, or not as the drive was last scanned, isn't sent. Stopped or interrupted, it carries on where it was.

```text
backdown pool send [OPTIONS] <PLAN>
```

### Arguments

`<PLAN>`
: The plan's number (backdown pool plans).

## backdown pool plans {#plans}

The pool plans made here, or one of them.

```text
backdown pool plans [OPTIONS] [ID]
```

### Arguments

`[ID]`
: A plan's number, to show it whole.

### Options

`--json`
: Print it as JSON, for scripts.

All of them also take the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.
